A little help for your next big thing.

Manglo is a collection of straightforward tools for independent sellers, creators and anyone getting a small business off the ground. Our aim is to make routine work easier: preparing a photo, checking a margin or planning a discount.

Useful by design

Every tool has one clear job. You can use the toolkit without creating an account, and the image tools process your files locally in your browser. We explain the assumptions behind calculations so you can judge whether they fit your business.

Small tools, thoughtfully made

The toolkit includes image compression, resizing, conversion and cropping, alongside profit and discount calculators. Our guides explain practical workflows using examples rather than promises of business success.

Have a suggestion or found an issue? Visit our contact page.
